title: Threshold 0.5: grow sooner, use more room
notes: The same ten keys as the amortized example, but the table grows as soon as α would pass 0.5. It still grows twice, just sooner, at the 3rd and 6th inserts, when fewer keys have to move: 17 in total instead of 21. The price is space: 10 keys in 23 slots.
